hod.name: Prof. B. S. Ogundare
hod.title: Head of Department
hod.message:
It gives me great pleasure to welcome you to the official website of the Department of Mathematics of the Obafemi Awolowo University, Ile-Ife, Nigeria.

This Department of Mathematics is one of the foundational departments in the University, established in 1962. It remains a principal stakeholder in achieving the aspirations and dreams of the founding fathers of this great University, Great Ife.

Over the years, the department has been and remains committed to delivering quality teaching, rendering good research, and serving selflessly towards the development of the community and the nation at large. At commencement of operations, the department ran two programmes, Mathematics and Statistics, from B.Sc. to Ph.D. level. Our graduates in these fields are our testament to the quality obtainable from this department.

Recently, in January 2025, the Council of the University approved the creation of a separate Department of Statistics from the Department of Mathematics.

This platform has been designed to serve as a central hub for academic resources, departmental updates, announcements, collaboration, and an alumni face to the entire world.

As the Head of Department, I am proud of our commitment to academic excellence, innovation, and the holistic development of our students, both undergraduate and postgraduate. I encourage all students, researchers, faculty members, and visitors to make full use of the resources and features available on this website.

Stay connected, stay informed, and continue to engage in meaningful academic pursuits.

pages.about:
Founded alongside Obafemi Awolowo University itself, the Department of Mathematics has been a cornerstone of scientific and intellectual development in Nigeria. Our faculty are dedicated scholars whose work spans pure mathematics, applied mathematics, and statistics.

We offer a stimulating academic environment that challenges students to think rigorously, reason precisely, and apply mathematical knowledge to real-world problems, from economics and engineering to data science and theoretical physics.

Our graduates have gone on to distinguished careers in academia, industry, government, and international organisations across the world, carrying with them the hallmark of an OAU mathematics education.

Professor Okoya graduated with a First-Class Honours degree in Mathematics from the Department of Mathematics, University of Ife (now OAU), Ile-Ife, in 1983. He subsequently earned M.Sc. and Ph.D. (Mathematics) from the same University in 1986 and 1989, respectively. He joined OAU as a Graduate Assistant in 1984 and rose through the ranks to become a Professor in 2003 — the first fully-bred alumnus to attain the position of Professor and Head of the Mathematics Department (2008–2011) at OAU. He is a life member of the Nigerian Mathematical Society (NMS) and the Mathematical Association of Nigeria (MAN), and a member of the American Mathematical Society (2000–date). He served the NMS as Treasurer (2006–2011), Editor-in-Chief of the Journal of NMS (2011–2022), Member of the Board of Trustees (2011–date), Editor of the Notices of the NMS (2016–2022), and Coordinator of the Fellows of the NMS (2024–date). He is a Fellow of both NMS and MAN, and has delivered keynote addresses, plenary talks, and lead papers at national conferences and scientific meetings. He has been invited four times to the International Congress of Mathematicians to deliver a paper (1994, Switzerland; 1998, Germany; 2022, Finland; 2026, USA). He was a recipient of many international Fellowships and grants for study visits to institutions in the UK, Austria, Germany, USA, and Italy. He was a TWAS Associate (1997–1999) in Chennai, India, and a Regular Associate to the Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP), Trieste, Italy (2001–2006). He was also the first Occupier of the Pastor E. A. Adeboye Professorial Chair in Mathematics, University of Lagos (2013–2017).

Ajao Saheed Oladele attended the University of Ilorin for his first degree, where he was awarded a B.Sc. (Ed) in Mathematics in 2006. In 2012, he earned an M.Tech in Applied Mathematics from Ladoke Akintola University of Technology (LAUTECH), Ogbomoso, Nigeria. He also obtained his Ph.D. in Applied Mathematics from the same university in 2019. His research focuses on mathematical modelling with a specialisation in epidemiological modelling.
